# Bindings nobody wrote for the parser

Three `specs/setup/README.md` files, copied as they were typed and never
edited — a fixture that is corrected to pass is the fake these exist to stop.
The tests under `tests/` hold `tools/doctor.py` to all three, so a ledger
somebody else typed is what the parser is proved on, not only the template
filled by its author. See `specs/changes/0043`.

| File | Source | Copied |
|---|---|---|
| `toil-tracker-3cd5b19.md` | `sargismarkosyan/toil-tracker` at `3cd5b19` — a consuming repository with a ledger in its own words: a bold stamp with a parenthetical, *The gate wiring ledger* as the heading, read-back commands in a fenced block | 2026-09-16 |
| `todo-change-c89e9dc.md` | `sargismarkosyan/todo-change` at `c89e9dc` — the reference repository, whose bindings predate the ledger entirely | 2026-09-16 |
| `livespec-1.3.0.md` | this repository at 1.3.0 (`1322cb3`), before ids existed | 2026-09-16 |

They are dated copies, not the repositories: what the parser was held to on a
date. A later copy is a new row here, not an edit to an old one.
